First, note the date format is likely DD-MM-YYYY: 11-07-1394 means 11 July 1394.  

Subtract 293 days:  

1394 is not a leap year (leap years in Julian calendar: divisible by 4; 1394/4 = 348.5 → not leap).  
Days in July 1394 from 11 July: 31 - 11 = 20 days left in July.  
293 - 20 = 273 days left to subtract after July.  

Go backward month by month from July:  
June 1394: 30 days → 273 - 30 = 243  
May: 31 → 243 - 31 = 212  
April: 30 → 212 - 30 = 182  
March: 31 → 182 - 31 = 151  
February: 28 (non-leap) → 151 - 28 = 123  
January: 31 → 123 - 31 = 92  
December 1393: 31 → 92 - 31 = 61  
November 1393: 30 → 61 - 30 = 31  
October 1393: 31 → 31 - 31 = 0  

So we land on 1 October 1393.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1393-10-01
